description: Restructure priv/pages/docs/learn/ai-chat-agent.livemd so the main path is one agent pid, two turns on that pid, and inspection of status.snapshot.details.conversation before any advanced hooks or internals.

comments.text: Rewrote priv/pages/docs/learn/ai-chat-agent.livemd around the beginner one-pid chat flow. Added runnable livebook metadata, self-contained setup and credential cells, removed lifecycle-hook-based history management from the main path, switched runtime startup to Jido.start() + Jido.start_agent(Jido.default_instance(), ...), added conversation inspection via Jido.AgentServer.status(pid).snapshot.details.conversation, kept runtime system-prompt updates with Jido.AI.set_system_prompt/3, and changed the streaming example to read status.snapshot.details.streaming_text. Verified with INCLUDE_FLAKY_TESTS=true mix test test/agent_jido/pages_test.exs:183, INCLUDE_FLAKY_TESTS=true mix test test/agent_jido_web/live/page_live_test.exs:278, and a mix run page-registry check for /docs/learn/ai-chat-agent.

title: Rewrite AI chat agent Livebook around the simple one-pid chat flow
